title: CoDrift: Compositional Drifting for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning is intrinsically multi-objective: a policy must remain compatible with the behavioral support of a fixed dataset while preferentially selecting high-value actions. We recast these objectives in a common form by viewing each as an action-space motion field that specifies how generated actions should move. This perspective enables heterogeneous learning objectives to be combined directly through field composition. Inspired by drifting models, we propose CoDrift, a compositional framework for one-step generative policy learning. CoDrift combines three objective-level fields into a unified policy field. The conditional field preserves state-dependent behavioral structure, while the marginal field pools actions across states to provide a more stable generative signal in the single-positive-sample regime of continuous-control offline RL. translated_title: CoDrift：用于离线强化学习的组合式漂移方法
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习本质上是多目标的：策略必须与固定数据集的动态支持保持兼容，同时优先选择高价值动作。我们将这些目标重新表述为一种共同形式，即将每个目标视为一个指定生成动作应如何移动的动作空间运动场。这种视角使得异构学习目标能够通过场组合直接合并。受漂移模型的启发，我们提出了CoDrift，一种用于单步生成策略学习的组合式框架。CoDrift将三个目标级场统一为一个策略场。条件场保留状态相关的动态结构，而边缘场跨状态聚合动作，以在连续控制离线强化学习的单正样本场景中提供更稳定的生成信号。价值场将生成的动作移向高价值区域。组合后的场实现了有效的策略学习。
tldr: CoDrift通过将离线强化学习的多个目标转化为可组合的运动场，统一了条件、边缘和价值信号，从而在单步生成策略学习中实现了稳定且高价值的动作生成。
en_tdlr: CoDrift unifies offline RL objectives as composable motion fields, combining conditional, marginal, and value signals for stable and high-value action generation in one-step policy learning.
